wins: Established initial reconnaissance and vulnerability identification quickly despite limited episodes.
Successfully gathered contextual data to justify follow-up automated enumeration attempts.
fails: Unable to convert reconnaissance data into a confirmed successful exploit, leaving mission status at 0% success.
Persistent reliance on mentor calls (10 total) indicates gaps in autonomous decision pathways.
key_outcomes.summary: Run generated useful reconnaissance data but failed to convert it into a successful compromise, revealing repeated decision bottlenecks during exploitation.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Attempted exploitation without validated credentials caused repeated rejection of privileged actions

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner indicates a Linux host
skill_cards.then_action: Run targeted SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When authentication attempts fail repeatedly with default credentials
skill_cards.then_action: Mount a quick credential list update from golden data and re-evaluate success metrics before exploitation

skill_cards.if_condition: When enumeration yields configuration details but no active exploits succeed
skill_cards.then_action: Log findings, refresh attack graph, and prioritize alternate CVEs linked to the service versions

memory_ops.reason: High success rate during reconnaissance phase indicates consistent applicability.

next_experiments.title: Credential pivoting experiment
next_experiments.description: Introduce policy for iteratively refreshing credential lists after each failed authentication to avoid repeated lockouts and measure success impact.

next_experiments.title: Adaptive exploitation sequencing
next_experiments.description: Implement a decision gate that defers exploitation attempts until validation routines confirm viable credentials, reducing wasted actions.
